def holtExponentialSmoothingAdditiveError(params, x): #

        previousLevel, previousTrend = s
        a = jax.nn.sigmoid(alpha)
        b = jax.nn.sigmoid(beta)
        trainingError = x - previousLevel - previousTrend
        levelEquasion = previousLevel + previousTrend + a*trainingError

        return (levelEquasion, trendEquasion), previousLevel + previousTrend + trainingError
    return jax.lax.scan(step, s0, x)
